card.name: Dose amounts in cancer regimens
card.fires_on: The unit of measure (mg) or the first digit of a number right after a drug name or dose amount, in dosing instructions for chemotherapy-related and rescue drugs such as leucovorin, levoleucovorin and irinotecan.

modes.label: mg after a number
modes.description: The unit mg right after a small dose number in a regimen.
modes.example: Administer vitamin B 12 1<< mg>> intramuscularly 1 week prior

modes.label: Start of a dose number
modes.description: The first digit or decimal point of a dose number right after the drug name.

card.writes: It adds little clear output; the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese characters and counting words.
